text_markup: One card, {card:Information Sifting}, uses a method other than a breach to establish a set of cards for the Runner to access. The Runner accesses those cards one at a time in the order of their choice. Each access is performed as a separate instruction. See {ref:rule_split_up_instruction}. Accessing cards in this way is an exception to {ref:rule_act_on_multiple_cards}.
text_plain: One card, Information Sifting, uses a method other than a breach to establish a set of cards for the Runner to access. The Runner accesses those cards one at a time in the order of their choice. Each access is performed as a separate instruction. See rule 9.11.4b. Accessing cards in this way is an exception to rule 9.12.2a.
